title: Disco
desc: A ground-breaking scientific experiment brings a deceased man to life. However, things take a turn when he tries to escape the facility after waking up with no memories.

title: Velaikkaran
desc: Arivazhagan, a slum dweller, works in a large food company. However, when he realises that they adulterate the food, he strives to fight them.

title: Sangathalaivan
desc: A humble textile worker meets a staunch Communist after a tragic incident. Subsequently, he joins the movement after enduring exploitation, sparking a fight for workers' rights.

title: Kadhalikka Neramillai
desc: A man falls for his boss' daughter and convinces his friend to pose as his father to gain approval for their marriage, resulting in a hilarious series of misunderstandings.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

title: Magadheera
desc: After waking from a coma with a new face, a man seeks vengeance on the thug who killed his lover. However, as he battles his enemies, he uncovers shocking truths about his identity and past.

title: Ennodu Modhi Paar
desc: Karthikeya, a man who is devoted to his family, faces a huge challenge as his violent and turbulent past begins to resurface.

title: Subham
desc: The women of Bheemili are unusually transfixed by a soap opera serial. When three friends who run the cable in town decide to dig into the situation, they uncover unimaginable secrets.

title: Nedunchalai
desc: Murugan steals groceries from passing trucks in order to make a living. However, things take a turn when he comes across Masani, a corrupt and perverted inspector.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Love Pannunga Life Nalla Irukkum
desc: Desperately in need of money and tired of the lustful advances of her boss, a sales executive teams up with a technician to rob a truck full of gold that belongs to her company.

title: Boomika
desc: An eager group of developers intends to renovate an abandoned property. However, unexpected interactions with the paranormal force them to rethink their decisions.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Chevaikalemai
desc: In a village, people are dying of strange circumstances which causes fear and chaos among villagers. A newly appointed police officer investigates and discovers absurd suspects.

title: Maan Karate
desc: During a trip, a group of four friends meet a person who forecasts their future by handing them a newspaper to be printed after four months. Later, they work hard to make his prediction come true.

title: Kodiyil Oruvan
desc: An ordinary IAS aspirant, who helps out many misguided youths in his locality and shares a close bond with his mother, takes on a huge challenge when he opposes a powerful miscreant.

title: Trigger
desc: An amateur set designer visits a dense forest to erect a set for an upcoming movie. However, he realises his mistake when he is informed of the growing tiger attacks in the forest.
